First SMR drives on Broadcom HBA AVL
Removes a key interoperability hurdle, easing hyperscale adoption and potential volume ramps.
Hyperscale validation is a strong demand signal and can accelerate procurement decisions.
Supports AI/cloud data growth at similar power/cost envelope, improving TCO.

This is a mid-cycle validation milestone in Seagate’s HAMR+SMR rollout aimed at hyperscalers. A larger catalyst would be disclosed purchase commitments, revenue impact, or additional hyperscaler qualifications converting to orders.
